label: rem:t-duality-color-tube
title: T-duality in color tube coordinates
html:
Remark. T-duality in color tube coordinates

The T-duality involution \iota \colon (X, z) \mapsto (z, X) (T-duality on elliptic fibres) acts on color tube coordinates as follows. Writing c = X - z, the dual point has base coordinate z' = X = c + z and color coordinate X' = z, yielding the dual color tube coordinate c' = z - X = -c. Hence

\begin{equation}\label{eq:t-duality-color-tube}
  \iota \colon (c, z)  \longmapsto  (-c, c + z).
\end{equation}

The symmetry F(X,z) = F(z,X) (T-duality on elliptic fibres) translates to covariance of the color tube cubic. The involution \iota carries the cubic at parameter z with root c to the cubic at parameter c + z with root -c. We verify this directly from F(c+z, z) = F(z, c+z), as F(z, c+z) is the color tube cubic at parameter c+z evaluated at -c.
